gen-gf-warnes-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads like a text serif with its curves left open and its x-height running generous. Warnes is best at loud, stretched display lettering, while Kadwa does the steady work of carrying words.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-piazzolla: Warnes draws every stroke at the same gauge, tapering each one to a loose tip before it can touch. Piazzolla follows with lowercase almost as tall as its capitals, and the serif text feels authoritative and unhurried.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-pridi: Warnes looks like thin plastic tubing bent into loops, spaced wide and stretched out for attention. And Pridi grounds it with a serif body whose small letters stand almost capital-sized.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-scope-one: Loopy, wide and bold, Warnes never swells or thins, while Scope One spills its counters into open space. Give the text serif a little extra size.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads as a dignified text serif, with big open counters in its a, e and s. Warnes is best at flat, unmodulated display strokes, and Slabo 13px at carrying lines of text.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-suwannaphum: Warnes has no swelling in its bowls, just flat ink strokes that taper off before they meet. Suwannaphum follows with a high, squared-off x-height and an open c, so the classic serif text feels dignified.
gen-irish-grover-gf-fauna-one: Fauna One reads in a literary, dignified voice. Irish Grover is best at rounded, sturdy display letters that thicken slightly at the sides, while Fauna One is best at a tall middle band with shallow ascenders.
gen-irish-grover-gf-hanuman: Irish Grover is playful and organic, with tall lowercase and a softly varied stroke in its a. Hanuman brings refinement, its high-waisted serif letters keeping wide-set terminals on the s.
gen-irish-grover-gf-kadwa: Kadwa brings a classic, editorial text serif with open-ended curves and a large x-height. Irish Grover is the playful partner, its gentle stroke variation making the strongest contrast with Kadwa's steadiness.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noticia-text: Literary and dignified, Noticia Text lets its curved letters open with a big visible entrance, bodies filling most of the height. Irish Grover is best at sturdy, mildly varied display letters.
